'''Pollillus''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the two-headed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Troig/Legends|Troigs]], including the famous sportscaster [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the planet had only recently been discovered by the [[galactic community]]. A [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] later, [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported on the efforts of one of the heads of the Pollillus Troig [[Dwuirsintabb]] to become surgically separated from the other head.

==Description==
Pollillus was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Troig">{{CSWECite|III|264|Troig}}</ref> located within the [[Vannell system]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> It was situated within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Vannell sector/Legends|Vannell sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> beyond the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]].<ref name="Secrets" />

Pollillus' surface featured several landmasses, which appeared green-[[Color/Legends|colored]] when viewed from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and numerous interconnected bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> There were no [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] on Pollillus that could have sprung surprise attacks on the evolutionary ancestors of [[Troig/Legends|Troigs]], the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|121|TRO 1-2|Troigs}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:FodesinbeedAnnodue-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Pollillus was home to the Troigs, such as Fodesinbeed Annodue.]]
The Vannell [[Star system/Legends|system]], including Pollillus, was first discovered by the wider [[galactic community]] not long before<ref name="Secrets" /> the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{FactFile|121|TRO 1-2|Troigs}} states that the [[Vannell system]] had been discovered "recently" by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and mentions that [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]] was one of the first [[Troig/Legends|Troigs]] to leave Pollillus. Since [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] depicts Annodue being on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] shortly before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the discovery of the Vannell [[Star system/Legends|system]] must have taken place not long before the battle.</ref> When [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] visited Pollillus, a number of curious Troigs left their homeworld aboard departing [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Secrets" />

Among those early emigrants were the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]],<ref name="Secrets" /> who, eager to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], boarded one of the earliest vessels to leave the planet.<ref name="FF" /> Annodue eventually became a sportscaster and one of the most famous Troigs to leave Pollillus.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|fodeandbeed|Fode and Beed}}</ref> The Troig developed a passion for high-speed racing, such as [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], due to the lack of similar events on Pollillus.<ref name="FF2014">{{FactFile2014|19|ANN 1-2|Fodesinbeed Annodue}}</ref>

By the date [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:4]], [[Dwuirsintabb]], a Troig resident of Pollillus, attracted [[Media/Legends|media]] attention when one of the Troig's heads, Dwuir, wished to become surgically separated from the other head, Tabb. Dwuir sought [[Medic/Legends|medical]] assistance from off-world, and the case was reported on from Pollillus by the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" /> At some point no earlier than [[36 ABY]], Pollillus was mentioned in a [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|guide]] to various species of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that was based on the research notes of [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="NEGAS" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Troig/Legends}}
Pollillus was the homeworld of the two-headed Troigs, a unique sentient species,<ref name="FF" /> members of which used a [[Troig (language)|distinct language]] in communication on their home planet.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Pollillus was the site of the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as the [[Twin Cities (Pollillus)|Twin Cities]],<ref name="HNN" /> although the planet was generally considered to be technology-poor.<ref name="Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pollillus was first mentioned in the [[2000]] "Fode and Beed" pack of the ''[[Star Wars: Power of the Jedi]]'' [[Hasbro]] toy line.<ref name="POTJ">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Fode and Beed (Podrace Announcers)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjfodebeed.asp}}</ref> The planet was provided its visual depiction in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', which was illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]] and [[William O'Connor]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vannell system, and therefore Pollillus, within grid square J-10.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
